title: Prescription Insurance on File: Plan-Class Settings for Savings, Rewards and Pharmacist Overrides
content:
Every coverage record under **Prescription Insurance on File** belongs to one of seven plan classes, and five class-level settings decide how that class sits alongside Kestrel's other programs and what the pharmacist may do with a drug utilization review rejection. This schedule lists the five settings for every class.

## What each setting records

- **Government program** — whether the plan class is a federal or state health care program.
- **Manufacturer copay card as secondary** — whether a manufacturer copay card may be applied as secondary to this plan class.
- **Rewards points on prescriptions** — whether prescriptions billed to this plan class may earn rewards points.
- **Discount program in lieu of the plan** — whether the patient may choose to pay with a discount program instead of billing this plan.
- **Pharmacist override of a drug utilization review rejection** — whether the pharmacist may resubmit a drug utilization review rejection with an override.

## Schedule by plan class

| Plan class | Government program | Manufacturer copay card as secondary | Rewards points on prescriptions | Discount program in lieu of the plan | Pharmacist override of a drug utilization review rejection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Medicare Part D Standard Plan | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial Copay Plan | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit | No | No | No | No | No |

## Reading the schedule by column

- The four government classes are the Medicaid class and the three Medicare classes; the two commercial classes and the workers' compensation class are not government programs.
- A manufacturer copay card may sit behind only the two commercial classes.
- Rewards points on prescriptions are open only under the two commercial classes.
- Choosing a discount program instead of the plan is open under every class except the Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit and the Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit.
- A pharmacist override of a drug utilization review rejection is open under every class except those same two.

*Example (hypothetical):* a patient whose only coverage on file is a Commercial Copay Plan reads "Yes" in all four right-hand columns and "No" under government program; the same patient with a Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit record reads "No" in every column.
